result.markdown:
For a small company, my top recommendation would be **BambooHR for HR management** or **Rippling if you want HR, payroll, and automation in one platform**\.

However, if your company is based in Canada, I'd look closely at Canadian payroll support, employment standards, benefits administration, and vacation tracking before choosing. Not all popular US HR platforms are equally suitable for Canadian businesses.

## Best HR software for small companies (2026)

Here are the five platforms I'd put on your shortlist\:

![Sign-In Options – Humi Help Centre](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9mWqRSM3P1eJs6n0VdnHNfotFvXGpaplFFaceXnz0mVugKpmCYgvbzmk3mPdzLPCLYC9J5IvkYh2aORqb7aA9O-LLTSwqMePhiOdOAg8IhubdL8Y-OXdsq2if0POXmxzmN-acAAXrXw_gqvX2KHxMPXrY9FlO0uyR-TRbUVaC9LHosYGnYT0HgHwlIzPDh5e?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Employment Hero (formerly Humi)**

(Best overall for Canadian companies)

- Canadian payroll and HR
- Employee onboarding and records
- Vacation and leave tracking
- Benefits administration
- Hiring and performance management

Payroll pricing reported from \$7/employee/month, with a \$70 monthly minimum. HR pricing is quote-based.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/en-ca/)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best for HR management)

- Excellent employee database
- Onboarding and document management
- Performance reviews

- Reporting and analytics

Canadian pricing starts at approximately \$360 CAD/month for companies with 25 or fewer employees. Canadian payroll requires a separate solution.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
